title: Tech Note: An Approach to Implementing a Panel Bar in 4D
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note's list box-driven, menu-parsed panel bar UI pattern is a classic-era custom-UI technique that remains functionally usable today, but such vertical navigation bars are now more commonly built using 4D's later, richer form object and list box capabilities (and sometimes web-based UI via 4D View Pro/Qodly for browser-facing apps) rather than hand-rolled list box panel bars.
related_updates: 4D's form object model and list box capabilities have continued to expand, offering more built-in options for modern navigation UI than were available in v16
Many modern 4D applications now offer web-based UIs where navigation bars are built with HTML/CSS/JS rather than native form objects
